# DuckDB

<!-- BEGIN generated by .github/scripts/plugin_pages.py from the package's describe.json -->

DuckDB database files: the `duckdb` source, from the `duckdb` package. Declare the package once in `dependencies.yml`; DRE installs it on demand:

```yaml
# dependencies.yml
plugins:
  - duckdb
```

### Profile fields

Set in `profiles.yml`, under `connections:`, in a target with `type: duckdb`.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `:memory:` | DuckDB database file (relative to the project), or :memory:. |
| `threads` |  | Number of threads DuckDB may use. |
| `memory_limit` |  | DuckDB memory limit, e.g. 4GB. |

<!-- END generated -->

## Notes

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| `path` | Database file, relative to the project directory. Default `:memory:`. |
| `threads`, `memory_limit` | Passed to DuckDB. |

Capabilities: `sessions`, `read_only`, `check` (via `EXPLAIN`).
